digest.component_or_area: fsck detection and doctor repair for dirty-tracker wedges
propositions: fsck must detect and classify three distinct dirty-tracker conditions: tracked store-artifact deletions restorable from HEAD, untracked regenerable compaction leftovers (SNAPSHOT.json and retired files), and orphaned .tmp-event-* files, each reported as a distinct JSON finding with per-class counts and paths

doctor --repair must heal wedged stores by restoring tracked deletions via git checkout, quarantining leftovers without deleting them, and leaving .tmp-event-* files for manual triage, all while the store converges cleanly

repair mutations must use scoped write-lock acquisitions (non-reentrant; lock released before reconverge self-locks) and record a backup ref at tickets HEAD before any mutation to provide a durable audit envelope
the repair mechanism must be idempotent: running doctor --repair on a clean store makes zero changes, creates no backup ref, and exits cleanly
